title: Medical Leave Condonation Policy
body: Students with attendance between 65% and 74.9% due to verified hospitalization, acute illness, or authorized emergency may apply for condonation. Submission of registered medical practitioner certificates, hospital discharge summaries, and parent attestation within 5 working days of resumption is mandatory. Condonation up to 10% maximum is subject to Senate Board approval.
verificationCriteria: Authentic Medical Certificate with Doctor Registration Number
Proof of Hospitalization / Prescription receipts stamped
Endorsement from Faculty Advisor within 5 working days of return

title: Hostel Curfew & Weekend Leave Pass Guidelines
body: Curfew for undergraduate hostels is 9:30 PM on weekdays and 10:30 PM on weekends. Overnight or weekend leave passes require digital consent via CampusDesk AI parent portal at least 12 hours prior to exit. Emergency exits after 10:00 PM require Warden on-call authentication.
verificationCriteria: Hostel dues clearance verification for extended stays > 5 days
Hostel Warden digital signature via SIS queue

title: Mid-Term Clearance & Hall Ticket Issuance
body: Students must maintain a minimum 75% attendance in each registered subject (or approved condonation order) and have cleared all departmental lab dues, tuition fees, and library fines by the clearance cutoff to auto-generate exam hall tickets.
verificationCriteria: Minimum 75% attendance or active condonation docket

title: Placement Drive On-Duty (OD) Attendance Credit
body: Students participating in campus placement drives, technical hackathons, or authorized corporate interviews are granted academic On-Duty attendance credit up to a maximum of 14 working days per academic term.
verificationCriteria: Career Development Cell (CDC) attendance punch record
Shortlist invite email from registered corporate recruiter
Faculty Mentor review and automatic attendance ledger credit

title: Mess Rebate & Extended Absence Reimbursement
body: Students absent from the hostel mess for 7 or more consecutive days on approved academic OD or medical leave are eligible for a prorated daily mess rebate of ₹140 per day credited towards next semester dues.
verificationCriteria: Approved CampusDesk Leave Pass spanning 7+ days
Biometric exit and re-entry timestamp match at Campus Gate

title: Continuous Assessment Re-evaluation & Scrutiny
body: Answer scripts for mid-term assessments and semester tests may be requested for re-scrutiny within 7 calendar days of mark declaration. An evaluation panel re-checks summation and grading against the official marking rubrics.
verificationCriteria: Specific questions / rubrics flagged in application
